messages.subject: Dynamic Window & Student Audit Complete
messages.body: We audited the Dynamic Window Attention operator, recurrent AnnotationExpert, and AdaptiveAnnotationStudent through mathematical analysis, backward autograd tracing, and empirical synthetic probes. We confirmed active DW execution under feature_only mode with complete audit channel zeroing and retained logits/entropy/image conditioning across single-pass encoder turns, but discovered that unconstrained joint training allows later-stage A2 gradients to cannibalize standalone A0 accuracy (dropping from 70.5% to 60.6%) while creating an artificially inflated headroom metric. We proposed a stop-gradient decoupled training strategy to preserve A0 optimality and established a mandatory matched-compute feedforward CNN baseline that eliminates the 2.16x latency penalty of dynamic grid sampling for rigorous future benchmarking.
